visualCharacteristics.purpose: Feature-story carousel with neighbouring slides peeking in
visualCharacteristics.description: Center slide with neighbouring slides peeking at the sides; text, heading and button overlaid on the photo bottom-left; arrows and bar indicators

contentPattern.structure: image cell, then a content cell with heading, text and one CTA link
contentPattern.rationale: Interactive rotating slides with arrows and indicators: Carousel. Source DOM duplicates the 4 slides for looping; only 4 unique slides are kept.

usage: Slide carousel where the current slide is centred and its neighbours peek in from the sides; heading, text and CTA sit over the photo bottom-left; prev/next arrows and bar indicators. One row per slide: image cell, content cell. Button labels come from the placeholders sheet (previousSlide, nextSlide, showSlide, of, carousel, slide, carouselSlideControls).
reuseGuidance: Use for 3+ feature stories with photos. For a single static banner use hero-gradient.

blockContent.description: 4-slide carousel: Performance Perfected, Superior Service, Family Owned American Made, Visionary Design; each image + H3 + text + CTA
